title: Work navigation refusals name the deciding check, its observed values and the remedy (catalog, next and notes-window cursors)
outcome: Catalog continuations survive unrelated project events, or their refusal names a stable way to finish the read
acceptance: The compact `next` and catalog continuation refusals name which check decided (clock reversal, project head X→Y, valid_until vs now, membership change) with observed values, and the `next` refusal names the remedy of starting `engram work ls` with the same filters, covered by behavioural tests

The notes/gates window refusal separates clock reversal from a change to the item's own selected records and reports the item, window kind and expected vs observed count or boundary, covered by behavioural tests

A behavioural test pages a multi-page `show --notes --gates` window and an explicit `ls` listing while another session keeps writing unrelated notes, gates and claim renewals, and both complete ordered and duplicate-free
